status: frozen before model setup and inference
purpose: Screen one distinct native non-thinking-only checkpoint for English/Greek translation under the unchanged production protocol.
hypothesis: The refreshed instruction-trained weights may improve fidelity within the existing output budget; generic multilingual support and benchmark gains are not evidence that these meaning errors are repaired.

request_profile.sampling_note: Native template and model parameter defaults are part of this package. Explicit production temperature 0 overrides native temperature 0.7; no publisher sampling change or explicit seed is introduced.

limits.memory_scope: Concurrent evaluator and owned Ollama process-tree RSS upper bound, with PSS also reported. Sampled at 0.2 s. Exceeding budget rejects and stops after the current case; this is not a kernel-enforced cap.

controls: Execute unchanged production enhancements.py; source hashes must match before and after.
Use the official native package without custom prompt, glossary, source-specific substitution, adapter, or request retry.
Compare actual request bodies with retained production baseline after removing only model name.
Observe every request and preserve raw returned JSON, errors, source metadata, structural results, and lexical review flags.
Require normal completion, nonempty final content, empty reasoning, and explicit unload acknowledgement before another case.
Stop the suite on the first execution, structure, protocol, cleanup, or sampled resource failure. Lexical flags are review signals, not semantic judgments.
One owned loopback daemon; one model and request at a time. Private startup logs stay outside the repository.
No summary calls, unused validation reads, heldout inference, or automatic promotion.

semantic_review.criteria: Use every existing case-specific proposition criterion. Preserve people/roles, numbers and units, negation scope, uncertainty, actions/conditions, chronology, and complete content. Fluency does not compensate for material changes.
semantic_review.major_error_rule: Any material omission, invention, role reversal, name substitution, quantity/relationship error, or changed condition blocks quality promotion.
semantic_review.interpretation: Six exposed owned scenarios form a development screen, not a general benchmark or v1 quality gate.

research_sources.supports: Distinct refreshed 4B instruction checkpoint, Apache 2.0, native non-thinking-only design; generic multilingual and instruction gains, not Greek-specific quality proof.
Official exact Q4_K_M tag, 2.5 GB package, manifest prefix 0edcdef34593.
Native template has ordinary assistant generation prefix without a thinking branch.
Publisher family-level language list explicitly includes Greek and English; no claim of measured task fidelity.

candidate_selection_limits: Qwen3.5 4B, TranslateGemma 4B, Hy-MT3 and Marian already have retained failed translation evidence. Official Qwen3.6 collection did not supply a verified small candidate within this budget. This checkpoint was absent from prior trial identities.
resource_expectation: Same 4B Qwen architecture and quantization class as the measured baseline. At 8192 context, a theoretical F16 K/V cache is approximately 1.125 GiB before graph/runtime overhead. This is a fit hypothesis, not a measured resource pass.
coordination: Parent approved controls and released the ASR inference slot at 00:56:21 UTC; actual inference begins only after verified pull-only setup and frozen-file preflight.
